name: CookiePilot – Cookie Consent & GDPR | Cookiebot Alternative
author: mlemiesz

sections.description:
CookiePilot is a professional, affordable alternative to Cookiebot — starting at just 29 PLN/month with no subpage limits. Unlike Cookiebot, you pay per domain, not per the number of subpages. No hidden costs. No surprises.

Manage cookie consent banners across all your websites from one central dashboard. Full compliance with GDPR, PKE, ePrivacy, and Google Consent Mode v2.

🇵🇱 Polish product — Polish support, Polish invoices (VAT), Polish law expertise.

Why Choose CookiePilot over Cookiebot?

  • ✅ 29 PLN/month vs Cookiebot’s expensive subpage-based pricing
  • ✅ Unlimited subpages — one domain, no traffic or page count limits on Pro plan
  • ✅ Polish support — chat and email in Polish, understanding of PKE & RODO
  • ✅ Ultra-light script (<15KB) — Cookiebot and others often ship 30–50KB+
  • ✅ Daily cookie scanning — competitors scan monthly
  • ✅ Free plan available — 1 domain, 10,000 pageviews/month, no credit card required

Compare CookiePilot vs Cookiebot →

Key Features

  • Visual Banner Editor — Customize colors, texts, and layout without any coding
  • Google Consent Mode v2 — Full compliance with Google’s latest requirements
  • Multiple Languages — Polish and English out of the box
  • Script Blocking — Automatically blocks 50+ tracking scripts until user consent
  • Agency Mode — Generate one-time installation codes for client websites
  • Consent Records — Store proof of consent for 5–6 years as required by RODO/PKE
  • Analytics — Track consent rates and user interactions
  • Stripe Integration — Manage subscriptions directly from WordPress admin

Cookiebot Alternative — Detailed Comparison

  • Price — CookiePilot: 29 PLN/month | Cookiebot: based on subpages
  • Subpage limit — CookiePilot: Unlimited | Cookiebot: limited by plan
  • Script weight — CookiePilot: <15KB | Cookiebot: 30–50KB+
  • Cookie scanning — CookiePilot: Daily | Cookiebot: Monthly
  • Polish support — CookiePilot: ✅ | Cookiebot: ❌
  • Polish invoices — CookiePilot: ✅ | Cookiebot: ❌
  • PKE compliance — CookiePilot: ✅ | Cookiebot: ❌
  • Free plan — CookiePilot: ✅ | Cookiebot: Limited

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Create a free CookiePilot account (no credit card needed)
  3. Customize your cookie banner with the visual editor
  4. Your banner is live — consent records saved automatically

Agency Mode

Web agencies can manage all client websites from one dashboard:

  1. Agency creates a one-time token in CookiePilot dashboard
  2. Client installs plugin and enters the code
  3. Domain is automatically linked to the agency account
  4. Agency manages all client domains from one place — white-label available on Business plan

Cookie Categories

  • Necessary — Essential for website functionality (always enabled)
  • Analytics — Usage tracking (Google Analytics, GA4, etc.)
  • Marketing — Advertising and retargeting
  • Preferences — User customization settings

Supported Trackers (50+)

CookiePilot automatically detects and manages:

  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Facebook Pixel
  • LinkedIn Insight Tag
  • Hotjar
  • Mixpanel
  • TikTok Pixel
  • And 50+ more trackers automatically blocked until consent

UODO & PKE Compliance

CookiePilot stores all consent records with full audit trails:

  • Who consented, when, what, and how
  • Banner version history
  • CSV/PDF/JSON export on demand
  • Consent retention for required 5–6 years
  • Full compliance with Art. 399 PKE and RODO Art. 7

External Services

This plugin connects to the CookiePilot API to provide cookie consent management functionality.

What data is sent and when

  • Domain registration: When you add your domain, the site URL is sent to create your consent banner configuration
  • Banner configuration: The plugin fetches your customized banner settings (colors, texts, layout) from the API
  • Consent records: When visitors interact with the cookie banner, their consent choices are sent to the API for compliance record-keeping
  • Pageview counting: Anonymous pageview counts are sent to track usage against your plan limits

Service Details

This service is provided by CookiePilot.

  • Service URL: https://api.cookiepilot.io
  • Website: https://cookiepilot.io
  • Cookiebot Alternative: https://cookiepilot.io/porownania/cookiebot-alternatywa
  • Terms of Service: https://cookiepilot.io/regulamin
  • Privacy Policy: https://cookiepilot.io/polityka-prywatnosci

The plugin requires an active connection to the CookiePilot API to function. Without it, the consent banner cannot be displayed or configured.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “CookiePilot”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to CookiePilot in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Create a free account or log in
  3. Click “Add this domain” to connect your website
  4. Customize your banner in the visual editor
  5. Save — your banner is live!

Compatible with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, and all major caching plugins.
sections.faq:
Is CookiePilot a good Cookiebot alternative?

Yes. CookiePilot is one of the most affordable Cookiebot alternatives on the market — 29 PLN/month (~7 EUR) with unlimited subpages. Cookiebot charges based on the number of subpages on your domain, which can get expensive quickly. With CookiePilot you pay per domain, not per subpage. See full comparison →

Does CookiePilot have subpage limits?

No. The Pro plan at 29 PLN/month includes unlimited subpages and unlimited pageviews for one domain. Unlike Cookiebot, we charge per domain — not based on how many subpages or how much traffic your site gets.

How much does CookiePilot cost compared to Cookiebot?

CookiePilot Pro costs 29 PLN/month (~7 EUR) with no subpage restrictions. Cookiebot pricing scales with the number of subpages, which for medium and large sites is significantly more expensive. For most Polish websites, CookiePilot is 5–10x cheaper.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. CookiePilot offers a free plan with 1 domain and 10,000 pageviews/month — no credit card required. You get the Visual Banner Editor and Google Consent Mode v2 included.

Is CookiePilot GDPR / RODO compliant?

Yes. CookiePilot is built for full compliance with GDPR (RODO), Polish PKE (Prawo Komunikacji Elektronicznej), ePrivacy Directive, and CCPA. It blocks all tracking scripts until the user gives explicit consent, and stores proof of consent for the required 5–6 years.

What is Google Consent Mode v2 and is it supported?

Google Consent Mode v2 is Google’s framework that requires websites to signal user consent choices to Google Ads and Analytics. CookiePilot fully supports Consent Mode v2 from day one — it’s included even on the free plan.

Does CookiePilot work with caching plugins?

Yes. CookiePilot is compatible with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, and all other major caching plugins.

What happens if the CookiePilot API is unavailable?

The consent banner configuration is cached locally in the browser. If the API is temporarily unavailable, your banner will continue to work correctly.

Can I use it on multiple WordPress sites?

Yes. The Business plan (99 PLN/month) covers 5 domains with unlimited pageviews, white-label branding, API access, and priority support. Agencies can also use the Agency Mode to manage unlimited client websites.

Is there Polish language support?

Yes — CookiePilot is a Polish product. Support is available in Polish via chat and email. All invoices are issued in PLN with Polish VAT. The team understands PKE and RODO requirements for Polish businesses.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Auto-detect the active page language from WPML and Polylang via the wpml_current_language filter and pass it to the banner — no more manual data-locale snippet on multilingual sites.
  • Fall back to determine_locale() / get_locale() when no translation plugin is active, so single-language WordPress installs get the correct WP-core language out of the box.
  • Banner widget now also honours <html lang="..."> as a fallback locale signal for non-WordPress hosts.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release
  • User registration and login from WordPress admin
  • Full visual banner editor with live preview
  • Visual Effects: Glassmorphism, Floating Card 3D, Gradient Accents
  • Entry animations: Slide Up, Slide Down, Fade
  • Toggle animations: Spring, Smooth
  • Consent button for re-opening settings
  • Agency mode with one-time installation tokens
  • Stripe payment integration
  • Google Consent Mode v2 support
  • Automatic script blocking for 50+ trackers
  • Multi-language support (Polish, English)
  • Pageview usage tracking and limits display
